learning_outcomes.text: Possess knowledge about chemical enrichment methods.
Learn enrichment methods such as flotation, flocculation, leaching, and crystallization, which can be used in many areas, especially in chemical enrichment technology.
Have knowledge about the theoretical basis of flotation and the effect of different parameters on flotation.
Have knowledge about the latest developments in the field of chemical enrichment technology.
Ability to make effective written and oral presentations.

syllabus_topics: Parameters Affecting Flotation (pH, Temperature, Concentration, and Flotation Time)
Flotation and Depression Methods (Solution Concentration and Density)
Leaching (Enrichment by Chemical Solubility Difference) Method
